title: Это моя кухня  (This Is My Kitchen)

segments.t: In the kitchen of Claude Monet, chaos erupts when a VIP guest suffers a severe allergic reaction to an unauthorized dish served by novice cook Max. Let's listen closely to the conversation in Russian first, and then walk through each line together.
Шеф, в зале гостю стало очень плохо!
Что случилось? Это не моё блюдо!
Шеф, это блюдо приготовил я.
Я заменил ваше блюдо на своё.
Ты вообще как посмел такое сделать?
Запомни раз и навсегда: это моя кухня!
Ты поставил под угрозу жизнь человека!
Пошёл вон отсюда прямо сейчас!
Алло? Да, Дима, я слушаю.
Какие новости из больницы, говори скорее.
Что? Врачи обнаружили у него аневризму?
Значит, это спасло ему жизнь?
Шеф, так значит, никто не умер?
Молчи, сегодня тебе просто невероятно повезло.
Let's explore the high-stakes kitchen crisis and its miraculous resolution.

'Chef, a guest in the hall became very ill!' Vika rushes into the kitchen with alarming news.

'What happened? This is not my dish!' The head chef angrily inspects the returned plate.
Шеф, это блюдо приготовил я.
'Chef, I cooked this dish.' Max steps forward to take full personal responsibility.
Я заменил ваше блюдо на своё.
'I replaced your dish with mine.' Max confesses his arrogant unauthorized swap.
Ты вообще как посмел такое сделать?
'How did you dare do such a thing?' Chef Barinov is incensed by the cook's insolence.
Запомни раз и навсегда: это моя кухня!
'Remember once and for all: this is my kitchen!' The head chef fiercely reasserts absolute authority.
Ты поставил под угрозу жизнь человека!
'You endangered a human being's life!' Barinov emphasizes the gravity of the medical emergency.
Пошёл вон отсюда прямо сейчас!
'Get out of here right now!' Chef Barinov uses the perfective verb meaning 'to go' to focus on the single completed result, pairing it with 'from here' and 'straight'.
Алло? Да, Дима, я слушаю.
'Hello? Yes, Dima, I'm listening.' Barinov answers a sudden phone call from the restaurant owner.
Какие новости из больницы, говори скорее.
'What news from the hospital, speak quickly.' Here Chef Barinov anchors the line on the word meaning 'piece of news' and builds the thought around 'hospital' and 'to speak'.
Что? Врачи обнаружили у него аневризму?
'What? The doctors discovered an aneurysm in him?' The examination unexpectedly revealed a hidden condition.
Значит, это спасло ему жизнь?
'Does that mean this saved his life?' The allergic reaction led to timely medical intervention.
Шеф, так значит, никто не умер?
'Chef, does that mean nobody died?' Max turns a statement into a question purely through rising intonation on the word meaning 'boss', pairing it with 'so' and 'to mean'.
Молчи, сегодня тебе просто невероятно повезло.
'Keep quiet, today you were simply incredibly lucky.' Barinov sternly warns Max of his lucky escape. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Saved by an astonishing coincidence, Max escapes disaster on his first chaotic day. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'aneurysm' and 'dish' — you will catch every word right away. See you in the next scene.
